purpose: Actual API planner -> strict scope validation -> fixed local tools -> official evidence -> independent numeric scoring.
source: Already-seen development questions, first two in the first six wording families. No sealed-test rerun.
gate: All 12 planned tasks have exact indicator/tool/period scope, correct numeric outputs and evidence IDs; any request/usage/model/plan/business error stops the first run. Denominator stays 12.

budget.authorization: Not granted for this pilot; existing connectivity budget is expired. User must approve freshly and recheck actual prices.

api.key_entry: User-local hidden interactive entry only; no key file/environment lookup.

outbound_scope: 12 public questions, indicator alias, permitted tools, available monthly periods and SHA256 snapshot fingerprint. No raw observed values, IMF content, personal files or private data.
limits: Small selected already-seen development pilot; not a blind test, prospective validation or unrestricted financial analysis quality.
Provider usage/model fields and local logs are evidence, not independent provider attestation. Offline rescoring cannot prove a live request occurred.

Token reservation is conservative under the documented usage bounds, not a guaranteed invoice cap; invalid/missing usage, timeouts and external pricing changes can cause billing uncertainty. No automatic retry.
No forecast-method improvement, model tuning, data refresh or sealed assistant rerun. Failed first run and incomplete denominator must remain.
